description: This Java class 'DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator' implements the 'AuthenticationFailureAggregator' interface. It aggregates multiple authentication failure results into a single exception, providing detailed failure reasons, descriptions, and headers. It handles failure collection, exception conversion, and message building for authentication failure scenarios within a security/authentication context.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator
classes.description: Final class implementing AuthenticationFailureAggregator, responsible for aggregating multiple authentication failure reasons into a single exception with detailed messages, headers, and descriptions.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Aggregates a list of failed authentication results into a single DittoRuntimeException, prioritizing non-401 failures or creating a combined exception with detailed descriptions and headers.

methods.name: getDittoRuntimeExceptionReasonsWithDescription
methods.description: Extracts and filters reasons of failure from authentication results, converting them into DittoRuntimeException instances that have descriptions.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Recursively converts a Throwable into a DittoRuntimeException if possible, or null if not.

methods.name: buildAggregatedDescriptionFromDittoRuntimeExceptions
methods.description: Builds a combined failure description string from a collection of DittoRuntimeExceptions.

methods.name: buildAggregatedHeaders
methods.description: Creates combined DittoHeaders from multiple DittoRuntimeExceptions' headers.
